sources.title: Moonvault litepaper & pitch deck
sources.excerpt: Play-to-own vault game. '250,000 daily players', '2M+ holders', '$5M monthly revenue'. Team pseudonymous. Token MVLT, 10B supply.

sources.title: Block explorer: MVLT token and game contracts
sources.excerpt: Token contract verified. mint(address,uint256) restricted to owner; owner is an EOA (0x7a3…). Game contracts are UUPS proxies; upgradeTo callable by the same EOA with no delay.

sources.title: Reviewer holder & activity queries
sources.excerpt: Top-10 non-contract wallets hold 62%. 6 of the top 10 were funded from the same address within one hour of deployment. 30d avg daily active addresses 31,000; 58% of them cluster to 14 funding sources.

sources.title: Market data + order-book snapshot
sources.excerpt: 24h volume $48M against ±2% depth of $90k (533x). 71% of volume on one venue.

sources.title: Audit — small firm, token contract only (2026-01)
sources.excerpt: Scope: token contract only. 1 high (owner mint) acknowledged, not fixed: 'by design for game rewards'.

sources.title: MVLT vesting schedule
sources.excerpt: Team 22% (6m cliff, 12m linear), investors 31% (3m cliff, 9m linear). Cliff for both on 2026-12-01.
